summary: DRDGOLD Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a release dated September 30, 2026, giving notice that its annual general meeting will be held remotely at 10:00 a.m. South African Standard Time on Friday, November 6, 2026, via The Meeting Specialist platform. The notice also announces availability of the annual integrated report and summary consolidated annual financial statements for the year ended June 30, 2026, plus a no-change statement. Salient dates include a September 18 record date, October 27 last day to trade, and proxy deadlines from November 2 to 5. This is a routine AGM notice, not a special situation.
